Mentoring. In Brazil, Intel volunteers teamed up with the United Way to
teach life skills to 30 teens and young adults. The volunteers shared their
own career experiences and provided information on how to interview
for jobs, manage personal finances, and more. Following the mentoring
program, 85% of the participants gained employment. The United Way
plans to replicate the program in other Latin American countries in 2009.
